1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __light-activated__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP remains light-activated__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards, __and wherein the MTP is light-activated__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __configured for long-term storage of biological samples, and wherein the MTP is light-activated__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __in a manner that preserves light-activation of the MTP__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__, __and wherein the MTP is light-activated__.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, __wherein the system is configured to read light-activated MTPs in the test tubes__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20 C or less, __wherein the light-activated MTPs remain functional at such temperatures__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a light-activated MTP in plastic __by heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP, such that light-activation of the MTP is preserved__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated MTP; and reading the MTP __using light activation__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated __and the light-activated MTP remains readable through the frost coating__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded light-activated MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20 C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __in a manner that preserves light-activation of the MTP__.
